PRODUCTION_DUPLICATE_LEDGER_GUARANTEE.reason: Unique production index and production duplicate audit are not verified.

before_apply: Deploy application guard and confirm no increase in 5xx.
Take a current backup/snapshot of arLedgers.
Run npm run audit:ar-ledger-idempotency:json against the target DB.
Require duplicateGroups=0, conflictingPayloadGroups=0, normalizedVariantGroups=0 and malformedKeys=0.
Approve a maintenance/canary window and verify connection privileges.
post_apply_verify: Verify index uniq_arledger_idempotency_key_v1 exists, unique=true and partialFilterExpression matches contract.
Repeat same-key race test against staging Mongo.
Monitor duplicate-key conflicts, 5xx and transaction abort rate.

rollback.application: Rollback the release ZIP or restore the previous application image if contract incompatibility is found.
rollback.database: Only after explicit approval: db.arLedgers.dropIndex("uniq_arledger_idempotency_key_v1"). No script in this gate drops indexes automatically.
rollback.data_mutation: No automatic delete, merge or repair is provided.
